impact.affected_asset: Browser DOM and origin context of Grand Prix Heaven; no bot execution or flag-capture trace is included.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause markup embedded in an uploaded JPEG EXIF tag to be interpreted by a visiting browser after the template-composition and F1-routing conditions are met.
impact.security_effect: Documented DOM-based cross-site scripting in the rendered favorite-car page.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker can persist custom JSON with a car configuration and upload a JPEG carrying HTML markup in its EXIF ImageDescription.

parseInt accepts numeric prefixes in custom object keys. The custom map is serialized using a known fixed multipart boundary, and the template service raw-splits on that boundary and appends templates for recognized names in resulting chunks. The organizer documents using this to include mediaparser and omit CSP composition.

mediaparser assigns EXIF tag descriptions directly to innerHTML. Requester accepts the [A-z] range, which includes backslash, before URL resolution; the organizer documents using normalization of backslashes to reach /media/.
The EXIF HTML is parsed as DOM markup at innerHTML, producing the documented DOM XSS condition and challenge flag route.

failure.operation: DOM HTML parsing caused by JPEG EXIF tag descriptions assigned to innerHTML

primary_invariant.kind: template composition, URL-path validation, and metadata rendering
primary_invariant.statement: A persisted custom template map must not alter protected composition, synthesize additional multipart template fields, route F1 outside its intended resource namespace after URL resolution, or cause untrusted EXIF metadata to be interpreted as HTML.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Numeric-prefix coercion weakens key validation; raw splitting on a known static multipart boundary permits parser-visible chunks; [A-z] permits backslash before URL normalization; and EXIF descriptions reach innerHTML.

quality.review_notes: The organizer writeup supplies a concrete EXIF command, multipart submission shape, and final URL; primary source confirms parser and sink behavior. No observed browser execution, bot implementation, flag capture, remediation patch, or maintainer fix exists in the bundle. Mitigations are analyst-derived, not source-proven.

remediation.invariant_restored: Require canonical integer-only template keys and explicit allowed mapping; do not raw-split multipart bodies on an attacker-representable static delimiter; validate canonical resolved paths; render EXIF using textContent; and emit CSP independently of attacker-selectable pieces.

target.component: Heaven service, template server, and browser-side media parser
